cues.text: As a group Owner, you can limit how many GitLab Credits each person uses. On the GitLab Credits dashboard, select Credit caps.
First, set a flat cap for everyone. Enter an amount, here 400 credits, and turn on Enforce cap.
The cap is per user, per month, and counts only after someone's included credits run out. Select Save.
Next, go back to the dashboard and look at Usage by user.
Priya has reached the cap, so her status shows Blocked usage.
To give one person more room, go back to Credit caps and select Add override.
Find the user, enter a higher cap, like 600, and save. The override replaces the flat cap for that person.
Once the override takes effect, Priya is back to Regular usage.
Caps work from recent usage data, so a little usage can land past a cap. For a hard stop, turn off GitLab Duo.
One flat cap for everyone, and overrides for the few who need more.
